title: Resilience playbook for sustained throughput dip and coordinated rollback flow
creator: Maya Singh
description: Summary: During a multi-hour incident on 2026-02-14 we observed a sustained 20-45% throughput dip across several Dedicated pools which impacted customer latency SLOs and caused throttling for high-throughput tenants. This ticket captures the incident timeline, the short-term mitigations we executed, the root-cause hypotheses, and an actionable resilience playbook including automated rollback coordination, monitoring hardening, and testing to prevent recurrence. The objective is to codify a single, operationally-safe rollback and mitigation flow that on-call and SRE can run reliably, plus a set of follow-up engineering changes to eliminate the regression surface.
impact_summary: Affected 6 Dedicated pools across two regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Total throughput loss peaked at 38% for heavy transformer workloads (seq len 1024, batch size distribution skewed). 12 enterprise customers experienced increased 95th percentile tail latency; two degraded past contractual latency SLOs triggering incident escalation. No data loss or security compromise.

root_cause_hypothesis: Interaction bug between a kernel selection optimization (PR #8342) and the autoscaler step-size reduction logic. The optimization changed micro-latency characteristics for certain sequence length distributions which triggered autoscaler to view transient backlog as sustained demand and reduce replicas prematurely, causing headroom oscillation and KV cache churn that reduced effective throughput.
short_term_mitigation: Rollback kernel-selection change from 2026-02-13 across affected fleets with orchestrator pre-checks.
Emergency increase of configured headroom by +30% for heavy pools and enable burst reservation for enterprise tenants while rollback validated.
Apply throttles for low-priority exploratory workloads to preserve capacity for SLO-bound customers.
Add synthetic canaries (profiled by seq len distribution) to dedicated pools to detect similar regressions within 2 minutes.
long_term_action_items: Implement an automated rollback orchestration routine: one-click rollback that runs pre-flight checks, drains canaries, and validates telemetry post-rollback (owner: Runtime team; ticket ENG-77501).
Add autoscaler safety envelope: prevent >20% replica reductions within 10 minutes without manual confirmation when headroom <25% (owner: Orchestration; ticket ENG-77422).
Introduce kernel-selection gating: enable new heuristics only after passing 3-stage canary (staging smoke, canary fleet 10%, canary fleet 50%) and synthetic-profile validation (owner: Runtime).
Enhance KV cache telemetry: track eviction rate, kv-hit latency, and per-tenant effective throughput and surface to Console dashboards (owner: Observability; ticket ENG-77450).
Add CI load tests that replay production seq-len and batch distributions to detect throughput regression before merge (owner: Platform QA).
Document rollout checklist and required metrics for SafeLaunch (owner: Developer Experience).
Conduct a quarterly chaos test that simulates autoscaler noise + kernel changes to exercise rollback paths and ensure the orchestrator correctly prevents thrashing.
runbook_changes: Add explicit rollback criteria to Dedicated Runbook: throughput delta >15% sustained for 10 minutes plus queue growth >30%
Define oncall checklist for rollback flow: identify offending change, trigger canary rollback, validate through synthetic and real telemetry, escalate to SRE lead if rollback fails.
Add procedure to pause automated downscales during immediate post-deploy windows (first 30 minutes).
Create post-rollback verification script that runs smoke queries and reports metric diffs to incident channel.
metrics_and_alerting: New Grafana alerts: DedicatedThroughputDropV2, KVCacheEvictionSpike, AutoscalerOscillationIndex.
Synthetic canaries per-pool: traffic generators for seq-len buckets [128,512,1024] with anomaly detection at 5-minute and 2-minute windows.
Add customer-facing SLA dashboard to Console for Dedicated customers impacted by rollbacks or mitigations.

acceptance_criteria: Automated rollback workflow implemented and validated in staging with synthetic profiles.
